title: DannyMC
description: A Vanilla+ modpack meant to be played by everyone!
body:
![The "DannyMC" Logo slash Banner.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1b264c13df6a2bdb7440bd54821f983e23b6c77.jpeg)

## Minecraft with just a bit... more. ✨

**DannyMC offers a refreshing experience while maintaining the Minecraft vibe.**

It's a Vanilla+ modpack that includes things such as new structures, revamped biomes, ambient sounds, and more! You can play with your friends or by yourself.





![Features Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3bed46e64814b1d7a82fd4403e11c887668be0cb.png)

**Performance-Centered**
> DannyMC was created in a way that allows it to run playably on mid-end computers, even with 100+ mods!

**Play with Friends**
> Using the Essential mod, you can play with your friends on one world. It's as easy as a few clicks!

**And Much More**
> The combination of mods, resource packs, and shaders aims to make this experience one of the best Minecraft experiences out there!

**...why is it called DannyMC?**
> cuz im dannymarsbar

**Additional Notes**
> This modpack and any associations were not assisted or created with AI in any way, shape, or form.
